response.sql:
SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) AS analysis_count, COUNT(ab.abhvreg)::NUMERIC / SUM(COUNT(ab.abhvreg)) OVER () AS proportion
FROM advancedbehavior ab
INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind

assumptions.assumption: "Both exist" means valid foreign-key references: advancedbehavior links to an existing transactionrecord, and that record links to an existing trader. INNER JOINs enforce this constraint.
"Without rounding" preserves full numeric precision by casting the numerator to NUMERIC type before division.
"For each trader type" includes only trader types that have at least one analysis record; trader types with zero filtered analyses do not appear in the output.

alternatives.interpretation: If the output should include all trader types from the trader table (even those with zero analysis records), use LEFT JOINs from trader through transactionrecord to advancedbehavior.
